text: ポケモンを　たくさん　つかまえて　もちきれない　ときは　パソコン　つうしんで　あずけると　いいよ

structure.jp: ポケモンを　たくさん　つかまえて
structure.en: having caught a lot of Pokémon

structure.jp: もちきれない　ときは
structure.en: when you can't carry them all

structure.jp: パソコン　つうしんで
あずけると　いいよ

patterns.name: 〜といい
patterns.explanation: A verb followed by と いい is a friendly way to give advice: 'it's good if you do this'. あずけると いい = 'you should deposit them'.

patterns.name: 〜きれない
patterns.explanation: きれない added to a verb says you can't do it all the way to the end, because there is too much. もちきれない = 'can't carry them all'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.span: つかまえて　もちきれない
patterns.explanation: The て ending joins one action to what comes next, like 'and' or 'and so'. つかまえて もちきれない = 'you catch them and can't carry them all'.
